title: Mitigating Sn2+ oxidation and enhancing device performance in tin-based perovskite solar cells via a CsTFA additive strategy
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,4674-4680
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00714C, Paper
Jiaqi Wang, Hongye Dong, Zhirui Chen, Jingjing Hui, Xiangning Xu, Zijin Qiao, Wang Yao, Qi Li, Cheng Mu
Cesium trifluoroacetate (CsTFA) as an antioxidant additive suppresses Sn2+ oxidation, passivates intrinsic defects and alleviates the p-type self-doping effect. This strategy enhances the efficiency and stability of tin-based perovskite solar cells.
